expectations.text: Grounds the recommendation in reach and effort rather than in the $4,800 price.
expectations.evidence: Reach is well covered. Most 'Why' bullets argue from reach: the realistic install rate is 15–30% (about 75–150 people), push only reaches installers who opted in, email reaches every registrant, and push 'solves a problem you don't have' because the schedule is locked. The routing rule ('anything someone would be harmed by missing goes through email') is also about reach. Effort is thin. It shows up only as attendee download friction on venue wifi and 'a static page can be done in an afternoon'. The organizer's effort to set up, populate and promote the app is never discussed.
